title: Bridging Villa Cap Ferrat
summary: Case study of a EUR 5 million bridging loan arranged by Silver Oak Capital against a large villa near Monaco (Cap Ferrat per the page slug and title) with an estimated value of EUR 8 million (62.5% LTV). Purpose: refinance an existing mortgage and release funds for refurbishment. The villa had planning permission to become a boutique hotel. Borrower: a Dubai-based client with hotel-asset experience and an income able to cover monthly interest. Terms: 0.55% per month, 24-month term, interest serviced monthly, 1.50% bank fee shared with Silver Oak. Challenge: many lenders had left the hotel lending market after the Covid-19 pandemic and the remaining ones were pricier; Silver Oak says it used its niche lender relationships to structure a bespoke mortgage. Lender not named (the 'bank fee' wording implies a bank). No dates or completion timeline revealed. Outcome as stated: the loan was arranged. The search tool reported that the /bridging-loans-uk/ page lists the same villa as a featured case with consistent details.
